item.title: LET RESULTS September and November 2025: Elementary, Secondary List of Passers
item.description: LET RESULTS ARE OUT! – The September and November 2025 Licensure Exam for Teachers (LET) or Teachers Board Exam results, together with the full list of passers, topnotchers (top 10), top performing schools and performance of schools, for Elementary and Secondary levels, are released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) on December 18, 2025, sixty-three (63) working days after the exam.
